title: Capturing Pieces
summary: Land on an enemy piece's square to capture it.

steps.text: You've learned that pieces move around the board — but they can also CAPTURE enemy pieces by landing on their square! Let's practice spotting captures.

steps.prompt: This pawn can capture in TWO different ways — either diagonal! Capture either black pawn.
steps.successText: Either one works — great job spotting a capture!
steps.retryText: Look for a diagonal capture — try d5 or f5.

steps.prompt: Spot the capture! Slide your bishop diagonally to grab the pawn on f6.
steps.retryText: The bishop can reach the pawn diagonally — try f6.

steps.prompt: Knights can capture too — hop onto the pawn at f5!
steps.successText: Great! Any piece can capture, as long as it can reach the square.
steps.retryText: Hop the knight in its usual L-shape to land on f5.

steps.text: Remember: to capture, you move YOUR piece onto the SQUARE of an enemy piece, following that piece's normal movement rules. You can never capture your own pieces! Next: let's learn about 'check' — when the king is in danger.
